description.narrative: Ghana - Agriculture Project - Irrigation Activity: Irrigation Development ("Irrigation Activity"): Aims to support the expansion of fruit and vegetable production by smallholder farmers, as well as the various farmer groups, by providing irrigated water to them. MCC Funding will support the following: (i) The rehabilitation or construction of a number of irrigation schemes, (ii) Feasibility and design studies and implementation of environmental and social mitigation measures.
